senses.gloss:
BHAVĀNĪ, s. (The wife of the god Śiva, and the goddess of
destruction; called Bhavānī in her amiable form) भवानी,
उमा, महादेवी, देवी.
— (The pure one) गौरी.
— (As terrible in
form and irascible in temper) दुर्गा, काली, चण्डी, चण्डिका.
— (As daughter of Himālā, the sovereign of the snowy
mountains) पार्व्वती, हैमवती.
— (As wife of Śiva) शिवा, ईश्वरी,
रुद्राणी, सर्व्वाणी, मृडानी.
— (The all-auspicious) सर्व्वमङ्गला.
—
(The mother) अम्बिका.
— (As the performer of austerities)
कात्यायनी, अपर्णा.
